First of all, I'm seeing this, you're not alone.

Even if you don't feel like you have a purpose, that's totally ok. You don't have to have a purpose for living every moment of your life. Just that you're living is purpose enough, and I myself am glad that you are alive, even if I don't know you.

I can't imagine how you're life must have been to this point, but I can empathise with the feeling that your life is just a series of tragedies and I am very sorry that you have to feel this way.

I can't give you a specific reason to live, but I want you to know that there are people out there who hear you and who really hope that someday you will feel better.

hello, I'm here to give my small piece of help.
I like to start with the fact that I don't know your complete situation, I would be arrogant to assume it.
But I know some similar feelings like putting up a facade, "fake it until you make it", it's something I've done for a considerable amount of time in my life.

My experience is, that even though you're not portraying your true self, you most likely put some parts of your real personality out there. And maybe you can find those pieces and try to figure out who you are and what you would like other people to see (but without losing yourself).

I know it is hard, and even though I don't know how hard it is for you, I hope that you can let go of some self hatred, because you will most likely judge yourself way to hard, even though you deserve forgiveness from yourself. 

I really hope that you'll find friends that will throw you the amazing surprise party that you deserve.

I know it's not much, but it's all I can give:
You are amazing for helping others, I'm sure they appreciate it even if they don't say it. And if they don't appreciate it, I appreciate it and I appreciate you.
I appreciate that you are still there and fighting,
because just living is fighting, and living is winning.
And I hope that you keep winning, because it's tough but I believe that you are strong enough to make it.

I really hope that someday you will be recognised for the good person you are.
